query: Can I request for a Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) physical card after 27 Feb 2023?
reference_answer: ICA had ceased the issuance of Long-Term Visit Pass (LTVP) physical cards from 27 Feb 2023. LTVP will henceforth be issued in digital format only.
answer: As of now, there's no information available to confirm if LTVP physical cards can be requested after 27 Feb 2023. [Document N]
